test.create_query: CREATE TABLE string_hash_table_dispatch ( u1_8 String, u9_16 String, u17_24 String, u25_40 String, r1_32 String ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO string_hash_table_dispatch SELECT substring(t, 1, 1 + h % 8), substring(t, 1, 9 + h % 8), substring(t, 1, 17 + h % 8), substring(t, 1, 25 + h % 16), substring(t, 1, 1 + h % 32) FROM ( SELECT cityHash64(id, 7) AS h, base64Encode(concat( reinterpretAsString(cityHash64(id, 1)), reinterpretAsString(cityHash64(id, 2)), reinterpretAsString(cityHash64(id, 3)), reinterpretAsString(cityHash64(id, 4)))) AS t FROM (SELECT cityHash64(number) % 10000 AS id FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) )
test.query: SELECT {key}, count() FROM string_hash_table_dispatch GROUP BY {key} SETTINGS enable_packed_string_keys_in_aggregation = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT toNullable({key}) AS k, count() FROM string_hash_table_dispatch GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
